title: Specters list v1
description: Body of GET /api/specters: every bot binding that has an active Specter, in ascending creation order, at most 500. A bot with no Specter is simply absent, and an archived Specter is not listed; the client joins this list to the roster by bindingId. There is no cursor because the roster itself is bounded at 200 bots per page and a single install has few Specters.
